author: Rahul kp
linked_mcq: Set-off and Carry Forward of Losses
topic: Set-off and Carry Forward of Losses
title: Set-off & Carry
hook: use the loss before you lose it!
simple_words: First adjust a loss against income of the same year; the balance goes to future years, within limits.

definitions.meaning: Intra-head (s.70): loss from one source against income from another source of the same head. Inter-head (s.71): loss under one head against income of another head.
definitions.note: Order: same head, other heads, then carry forward

definitions.meaning: These losses are set off only against specified income: speculative (s.73), s.35AD (s.73A), LTCL (s.70(3)), race horse (s.74A).
definitions.note: No set-off vs s.58(4) winnings, s.115BBE income; VDA loss (s.115BBH) none

key_points: Order: ==intra-head== set-off first, then inter-head, then carry forward of the balance
Unabsorbed depreciation: no time limit; set off against any head except !!Salaries!! (s.32(2))
Carry forward needs return filed by due date u/s 139(1) (s.80); !!not for HP loss and unabsorbed depreciation!!
==Speculative==, s.35AD, LTCL and race horse losses: set off only against the same kind of income
formula_hook: learn the table, win the MCQ

rows: STCL: any CG; LTCL: LTCG only

insight.text: Each loss has its own set-off field and time limit; under s.115BAC, HP loss gets no inter-head set-off or carry forward.

memory_trick.explanation: Speculation and race horses are bets: 4 years. HP, business and capital losses: 8 years. Unabsorbed depreciation and s.35AD loss: no limit.

steps: Set off within the same head
Then set off against other heads
Carry forward balance by its limit
Check return filed by due date
exam_tip: In any loss question, check the regime, the head and whether the return was filed on time before you set off or carry forward.

doubt.question: Can unabsorbed depreciation be set off against salary?
doubt.answer: No. Under s.32(2) it is added to next year's depreciation and acts like business loss, so s.71(2A) bars Salaries. It carries forward without time limit.

mistakes.wrong: Business loss can be set off against salary income
mistakes.right: Non-speculative business loss can be set off against other heads except Salaries (s.71(2A)).

mistakes.wrong: HP loss under s.115BAC is carried forward for 8 years
mistakes.right: Under s.115BAC, HP loss gets no inter-head set-off and no carry forward.

mistakes.wrong: Business or capital loss carries forward even if the return is late
mistakes.right: Return by due date u/s 139(1) is needed (s.80); HP loss and unabsorbed depreciation are exceptions.

mistakes.wrong: LTCL can be set off against short-term capital gain
mistakes.right: LTCL is set off only against LTCG (s.70(3)); STCL can be set off against STCG or LTCG.

applicability: Income-tax Act as per Finance Act, 2025 (June 2026 term)
reviewer_note: Verify: s.71(3A) HP loss inter-head cap (₹2 lakh) in the old regime; s.115BAC bar on HP loss set-off and carry forward; s.80 exceptions; s.35AD loss and s.73A treatment. No past-paper list was given.
check_notes: Checker 1: Insight text: it says that under s.115BAC, HP loss gets no inter-head set-off and no carry forward. The carry-forward part is wrong. s.115BAC(2) only blocks setting off HP loss against other heads. It also blocks carrying forward any loss that comes from deductions the regime disallows, such as s.24(b) interest on a self-occupied property. HP loss from a let-out property that cannot be set off can still be carried forward for 8 years under s.71B, against HP income only. Correct version: 'Under s.115BAC, HP loss cannot be set off against other heads, but the unabsorbed HP loss (e.g., from a let-out property) can be carried forward for 8 years against HP income under s.71B.'

Checker 1: Mistake 2: the 'wrong' statement ('HP loss under s.115BAC is carried forward for 8 years') is actually correct for let-out property, and the 'right' version ('no inter-head set-off and no carry forward') teaches a false rule. Correct version: wrong = 'Under s.115BAC, HP loss can be set off against salary up to ₹2 lakh'; right = 'Under s.115BAC, HP loss cannot be set off against any other head, but it can be carried forward for 8 years against HP income only (s.71B).'
